messages:
kate: Quick mobile report 70: on small screens the timepicker overlay covers the scrubber when pinned; when sampling is On the preview heatmap is heavily downsampled and the scrub thumb jumps when I tap presets. Repro: Phone emulation, 30m range, sampling=On. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/mobile-timepicker.png

drew: Repro'd on Android emulation. The overlay is full-width and pushes the scrubber into a second layer. Tap causes layout shift. Maybe the timepicker should be inset and not cover the main chart on small screens.

mike: UX thought: for compact/mobile the timepicker can be a bottom sheet that only overlays the control area (not the chart). Also when sampling is On show a subtle banner: "Approximate percentiles" to avoid surprise.

anita: Accessibility: bottom sheet must trap focus and restore it to the opener when closed. For touch, ensure large hit targets and stateful announce: "Time range set to Last 30 minutes" via aria-live. For touch, ensure large hit targets and stateful announce: "Time range set to Last 30 minutes" via aria-live. Also avoid truncated labels like '30m' 100% readability for SRs.

kate: Microcopy proposal: presets use full text 'Last 30 minutes' / 'Last 6 hours' and the sampling hint: 'Sampling reduces compute for long ranges; disable for exact percentiles.' No parentheses.

drew: Implementation approach: 1) make timepicker bottom-sheet on widths < 540px, 2) pin scrubber above chart (z-index) and keep it in overlay layer, 3) when presets tapped while scrubbing, debounce layout changes until touchend.

mike: Also propose a compact sampling toggle that expands to show the banner on first use: 'Sampling is on: results are approximate' with a link to docs. Banner should be dismissible and keyboard-focusable.

anita: For a11y: ensure the banner is aria-live="polite" and is focusable. When user toggles sampling announce full state: 'Sampling turned off, results now exact'. Use words not abbreviations.

drew: Small touch-nit: add a 6px visual handle to indicate the scrubber is draggable in compact mode. Helps discoverability on touch.

kate: Devs: can we avoid remounting the heatmap during preset taps by layering the bottom sheet and keeping the DOM for the chart stable? If we crossfade buckets instead of remounting we avoid jumpiness.

mike: Yep. We'll keep the chart DOM mounted and animate fade between bucket sets. Also keep scrubber/thumb in overlay via translate3d so touch taps don't repro layout.

anita: Keyboard flow on small screens (external keyboards) should mirror desktop: ESC closes sheet and returns focus to opener, arrow keys scrub and announce step size. Add aria-labels like 'Scrub left'/'Scrub right' for buttons.

kate: Sounds good. Please include a small changelog: 'Console (mobile): make timepicker a bottom sheet, stabilize scrubber during presets, add sampling banner & improved screen-reader announcements.'

a11y-bot: Quick checklist: bottom sheet traps focus, restores focus on close, banner aria-live polite, full-text preset labels, scrubber overlay uses tabindex=0 and announces p95 on scrub. Automated checks pass after PR.

drew: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/10321  bottom sheet + overlay + banner. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2201234567

kate: Verified on iOS emulator. Banner appears, scrubber stays put when tapping presets, VoiceOver reads preset changes. Nice work :sparkles:

mike: Will ship as a small mobile UX patch. Thanks everyone!
